claude_proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect (spell Effect union)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's save_gate onFail must apply a condition (blinded or deafened). The Effect union for ActivationPhase only has DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The v4 atom apply_condition exists but is absent from the spell Effect union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: One creature ... must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "blinded" | "deafened"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type only contains "prone". Blindness/Deafness requires "blinded" and "deafened". These are standard SRD conditions and will be needed by many spells and features.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration

claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save ActivationPhase variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has an ongoing repeat-save-to-break mechanic: at the end of each target turn, the target repeats the save and ends the spell on success. ActivationPhase has attack_roll and save_gate but no repeat_save variant. v4 atom repeat_save exists but is unrepresented in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: caster_choice_condition (Effect or ActivationPhase variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The caster chooses at cast time whether the condition is blinded or deafened. No existing surface type models a 'choose one of [conditionA, conditionB] at caster's discretion' mechanic. This differs from a random or target-determined branch.
